correctness.rationale: In characteristic two the cross-product terms cancel in the additive Zorn commutator. For operand coordinates (a,α,w) and (c,β,t), with α,β the traces and w,t the off-diagonal six-vectors, the target has equal diagonal entries s=ω(w,t), where ω is the split nondegenerate alternating pairing, and six-vector W=αt+βw. For a fixed first operand with α≠0, the image is the graph s=ω(w,W)/α and each attained target has q² second operands (β and c free). For W≠0 there are (q−1)q⁶ such first operands (q−1 choices of α, q choices of a, q⁵ choices of w), yielding (q−1)q⁸ pairs. For α=0 and w≠0 the image allows W in kw and all s; each attained target has q⁶ preimages, from a determined β, one affine hyperplane of t, and free c. A nonzero W admits q(q−1) such first operands, contributing (q−1)q⁷, so the total (q²−1)q⁷ is independent of s and norm. For nonzero scalar targets only α=0,w≠0 contributes, giving q(q⁶−1)q⁶=q¹³−q⁷. For z=0 all trace-zero nonscalars contribute that same number; scalar first operands add q⁹, and trace-nonzero first operands add (q−1)q⁹. This gives q¹³+q¹⁰−q⁷, and normalizing by q¹⁶ gives the stated commuting probability. All trace-zero fibers are positive for q≥2 and the trace obstruction handles all other targets. This fixed-first-operand count proves the parameter-general law without relying on binary enumeration or four-element samples.
residual_risks: The supplied checker evaluates the fiber-sum test at q=2, not symbolically at multiple field sizes as suggested by one description in VERIFICATION.md. The general law and sum identity follow from the exhaustive algebraic partition and do not depend on that description.

value.rationale: This is a full distribution for a canonical map on a natural family, not a test at the smallest field or a recomputation of commuting probability. It exposes an enlarged scalar stratum specific to characteristic two and shows uniformity on the nonscalar trace-zero targets despite their different norms. The exact multiplicities give a benchmark and explain which distinctions the usual centralizer count misses.
residual_risks: No claim to classify the internal orbit structure of these fibers or to settle finite-field Cayley value distributions for other words.
